name: Generic Tool Action Profile
description: Example mapping profile for representing a tool invocation as a MASG v1.0.0 authorization decision. This is a schema/example only and is not a working tool adapter.
security_invariants: The adapter MUST derive principal from an independently authenticated identity source; model output and caller-supplied principal strings are not identity proof.
Each invocation MUST map to one exact action, stable target identifier, and least-privilege scope.
Unknown or ambiguous tool identity, action, target, scope, policy version, or required extension MUST fail closed.
An ALLOW decision does not execute the tool; the adopting runtime MUST enforce the decision at every protected side-effect path.
Tool input, description, output, and peer messages MUST remain untrusted data and MUST NOT create or elevate authority.
limitations: This example defines a mapping convention only; no MCP, A2A, HTTP, or other transport adapter is implemented.
It does not authenticate identities, execute tools, enforce OS boundaries, or prove complete mediation.
Target naming, operation vocabulary, and scope semantics require agreement between the tool adapter and deployment policy.
